title: optimoptions
summary: Create or update solver-specific optimization options.

gpu_support.notes: Options are host metadata. Automatically resident option values gather transparently; explicit gpuArray option values are a gated RunMat extension.

description: `optimoptions(solver, name, value, ...)` builds solver-specific optimization metadata, and `optimoptions(existing, ...)` copies and updates an existing RunMat options struct.
behaviors: RunMat implements a compatibility subset for its optimization solvers and currently returns a struct rather than MATLAB's solver-options object class.
Recognized option names, defaults, aliases, and validation depend on the selected solver.
Native integer option values are independently gated RunMat extensions because documented numeric options use floating classes.

Integer tolerances must be exactly representable before normalization to double. Integer iteration and evaluation limits are parsed as exact structural counts, and accepted 0/1 flag values become logical fields.
Automatically resident option values gather into host metadata. Explicit gpuArray option values are rejected in compatibility mode before gather.

examples.description: Create options for a nonlinear solver
examples.output: opts is a RunMat options struct for fsolve
